features.title: Master & Director Settings
features.body:
Use Director Settings for size, steps, seed, execution and continuity. Use the Master for shots, prompts, references and review.

  • Keep a fixed seed while comparing a setting. Increment, decrement or randomize requests the next variation.
  • Only selected shots are generated when Generate selected shots is enabled. Unselected source ranges can pass through unchanged.
  • Validate a completed take to approve it. Reuse also requires matching inputs and files; changing a chained shot can invalidate its successors.
  • Generation uses a 24 fps frame grid: 5, 22, 39, 56, 73… frames. Width and height must be multiples of 32.
features.detail:
All-in-One Generation is the usual execution mode. Clip-by-clip stops after one new shot; full-batch processes the sequence. Manual resolution uses your dimensions, Auto uses aspect and megapixels, and Original snaps the source dimensions to the grid. Active working-resolution overrides take precedence.

Prompts and shot LoRAs

  • Example: A cyclist turns onto a wet street. Low tracking camera. Evening shop lights. Tires hiss on pavement.
  • Use raw text or structured editing; shared text supplies recurring instructions.
  • Mention selected media with the editor’s reference tokens. Check resolved_prompt to see what H3 receives.
  • Attach up to 8 LoRAs per shot.
  • Start with a moderate strength; compare with the same seed.
  • LoRAs modify the model; reference assets and RefMods supply media.

features.title: Reference pool, RefMods & timed guides
features.body:
Add & prepare reference media

  • Trim video/audio by start/end seconds; choose video, audio or both. The waveform shows decoded audio peaks.
  • Crop images/video using the rectangle or numeric fields. Scale with Off / Auto / Target / Fit / Fill; crop or pad to the required grid.
  • Set role and description. Subject/place/style/keyframe/pose are descriptive labels; pose is not a skeleton ControlNet.

Use RefMods & bundles

  • Use <RefMod 1> or <RefMod 1:memberName> to mention a bundle/member.
  • Expanded members count toward the normal reference limits.
  • RefMods organize reference assets; this node does not train or create a new RefMod model.

Place a guide at a time

  • Enter the guide time in seconds inside the visible shot.
  • The native AddGuide path offsets the anchor for a continuity prefix.
  • Check the reference and timestamp when an anchor lands at the wrong point.
features.detail:
Limits: 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audios, 12 combined; each reference video and their total duration must be ≤15 seconds. Native H3 may impose additional combination constraints. Crops retain the original asset; picking a source frame uses the original player time.

This is a timestamped native guide, not an additional guide-strength control.

features.title: Edit or extend a source video
features.body:
• Use V2V/RV2V and describe the desired edit. The source becomes reference Video 1.
  • Split at the playhead, split equally or use optional scene detection. Merge only contiguous ranges from the same file.
  • Leave other ranges unselected for source passthrough; generated ranges are trimmed to the source length.
features.detail: There is no generic source-latent strength slider. Automatic continuity prefixes are disabled for source edits. Scene detection needs scenedetect[opencv]. To extend a video, use locked source Clip 0, then add generated shots. Source ranges keep original-time coordinates.

features.title: Draft prompts, then review them
features.body:
• Choose a provider: local Transformers/GGUF, Ollama or a compatible API. Select images if the provider supports vision.
  • Edit draft cards for prompt, duration and mode before applying; stale drafts are rejected when their source context changed.
  • For graph use: Local Prompt Model → Prompt Forge Draft → Review / Apply Prompt Draft; explicitly enable apply and choose append/replace.
features.detail: Provider requests run on the server: localhost means the remote ComfyUI machine. Local models do not auto-download. UI keys remain in the panel, but graph key widgets can be serialized in workflows. Avoid wiring a draft back into the same Master through a graph cycle; use a snapshot or the editor draft flow.

features.title: Reuse, resume or branch a take
features.body:
• Load Take Checkpoint: choose project ID, clip ID and latest or an explicit take UUID.
  • Connect a checkpoint to continue from that take. Use explicit IDs for a branch.
  • Advance Staged Take returns staged when its gate is true; otherwise it returns current.
features.detail: Cache contains completed media/latents and manifests. It cannot resume an unfinished sampler step. Missing files or changed inputs prevent reuse. Advance does not judge which take looks better.

features.title: Move or merge a project
features.body:
• Workflow JSON: graph and node settings. Lightweight project JSON: timeline/settings with asset and cache hints.
  • Portable .mmxproj: includes reference/source bytes; excludes models and heavy generated takes.
  • Append remaps incoming IDs; overwrite replaces authoring. New Project / Reset Timeline / Clear Cache have different scopes.
features.detail: Clear Cache removes generated takes while retaining uploaded assets. Appended shared references become local to imported shots. Back up generated-take storage separately when moving servers.

features.title: Generate low resolution, finish high
features.body:
• Start at lowres_scale 0.5; reserve 4 high-resolution steps as an initial trial.
  • Choose the split with highres_steps or transition_step. Use a compatible model_hires override only when needed.
  • Use interpolation or compatible learned latent weights; tiling/chunking can reduce working memory.
features.detail:
The weight dropdown has no explicit “interpolate” entry: when no weights are installed, its unset placeholder falls back to interpolation. native_low_carry reuses compatible low-resolution context only for chained shots. rho=0 disables the optional pixel-anchor mix; w_min/w_max bound its weighting.

ControlMeaning
lowres_scaleSpatial scale of the initial stage.
highres_steps / transition_stepChoose the resolution-switch location.
native_low_carryReuse low-resolution context between compatible chained shots.
rhoEnable/control mixing with a VAE pixel-anchor path.
w_min / w_maxBounds for the anchor mix weighting.
model_hiresOptional MODEL for the high-resolution stage.
tiling / chunkingSpatial sampling tiles and learned-latent temporal chunks.

features.title: Refine or upscale a latent
features.body:
Refine an existing latent

  • refine: another sampling pass. upscale: enlarge then refine. latent_upscale: enlarge without diffusion.
  • Start with one pass; adjust target size, steps and denoise. Default controls include 3 steps and denoise 0.45.
  • Global backend plans tiles from the memory budget; sampler backend uses explicit tile_count/overlap.

Learned upscaling, tiles & chunks

  • Weights must match the supported 24-channel 3D architecture; arbitrary image upscalers do not work here.
  • Spatial tiles overlap and blend. Temporal chunks reduce memory but may change attention/normalization behavior.
  • Choose auto / bf16 / fp16 / fp32 precision as supported; use interpolation when learned weights are unavailable.
features.detail:
Optional refine_model must be compatible. SIGMAS must be 1D, finite, nonnegative and nonincreasing, with ≥2 entries. More passes (1–20) cost compute and can drift.

ControlUse
refine_modelOptional compatible model for later refinement.
passesRepeat refinement; supported range is 1–20.
sampler / schedulerChoose the refine sampling procedure.
SIGMAS inputSupply an explicit noise schedule.
global backendMemory-aware planner and temporal/spatial refinement.
sampler backendExplicit native sampling alternative with per-step spatial tiles.
upscale_precisionauto, bf16, fp16 or fp32 for learned latent weights.

Supported checkpoint extensions: .safetensors, .sft, .pt, .pth. Loading validates architecture. Audio stays separate from visual latent enlargement.

features.title: Repair one tracked face
features.body:
• Select a compatible face detector; choose largest-face or centre-most initial selection.
  • Set crop size/context, prompt and sampling strength; preview the tracked result.
  • Control pasted region, feather/dilation, color matching and blend. Blend 0 preserves the base frames.
features.detail:
Tracks one face, samples native audiovisual crops and keeps the main audio. No detections means a reported skip; a missing detector is a setup error. Inherit or offset the shot seed; stitching fades edits near boundaries.

ControlEffect
confidence / selectDetection threshold; initial largest-face or centre-most selection.
crop_factor / crop_sizeHow much surrounding context is sampled.
canvas_modeManual crop canvas or an automatically capped one.
paste_regionFace rectangle, ellipse or full crop.
mask_dilation / featherExpand and soften the pasted region.
colour_match / blendMatch crop color and control how much to paste.
steps / sampler / scheduler / SIGMASSampling of the face crop; separate from the main pass.

features.title: Conditioning adaptation & model acceleration
features.body:
• Semantic Bridge: install the exact student checkpoint under models/semantic_bridge; connect the pack and set alpha (default 0.15).
  • Cache: place Cache between a Load Diffusion Model and the corresponding Master model socket; adjust reuse threshold, active interval, maximum cached steps and device.
  • Compare quality against a baseline: reused model computation can introduce artifacts.
features.detail: Semantic Bridge adapts conditioning tokens. Cache defaults include threshold 0.05, start 0.15, end 0.90 and max steps 2. Its model hook depends on installed ComfyUI compatibility; no measured speedup is promised.

features.title: Upscale decoded frames
features.body:
• bicubic: resize. learned_pixel: supply an UPSCALE_MODEL.
  • RTX VSR / RTX High Bitrate: require their optional providers and compatible hardware/runtime.
  • Set target width/height; keep the Master audio connected separately to the exporter.
features.detail: Bicubic and learned-pixel paths resize to the target, including stretching. resize_method applies to RTX providers. These tools work on pixels, unlike SelfLift/latent Refine.

features.title: Playback speed, watermark & loop
features.body:
Change playback FPS

  • resample: repeat/drop frames to preserve duration; this is not AI motion interpolation.
  • retime: change speed and audio pitch; the waveform is resampled.
  • Set exporter FPS to the processing output’s timing.

Watermark & loop

  • Choose text or a logo, corner and opacity; a supplied logo takes precedence.
  • For loops, overlap end and beginning and crossfade picture + audio.
  • Overlap 0 disables looping; positive overlap must be less than half the clip. Output becomes shorter by the overlap.
features.detail: Example: 124 frames with 12-frame overlap produces 112 frames. Check the seam and sound before saving.

features.title: Advanced codecs & audio export
features.body:
• Set FPS, filename prefix, container and codec; enable save_output for permanent output rather than temp.
  • Use MP4 + H.264 for a first compatibility test. Other options include MKV/WebM/animated WebP/AVIF, H.265/VP9/AV1 and 8/10-bit paths.
  • Choose audio codec, metadata, crop-to-audio or ping-pong as needed.
features.detail: PyAV is default; FFmpeg is an explicit fallback. Codec/container support depends on installed builds. Audio options include Auto/AAC/Opus/MP3/FLAC. Passthrough frames does not disable encoding; preview transcodes can differ from the saved codec.

features.title: Export saved shots or a complete project
features.body:
• Choose all or selected shots, export FPS and optional individual shot files.
  • Select final, pre_refine or original_source stream.
  • Export assembles saved shots one at a time; generate missing takes before exporting.
features.detail: Final is the finished cached take; pre_refine uses its saved first-pass stream; original_source uses source ranges. Missing pre-refine can fall back to source when present. Assembly normalizes the canvas and uses H.264 MP4 with FFmpeg concatenation; it needs the original cache/assets.

features.title: Choose a different model for a shot
features.body:
• Give each compatible model entry a name; select that name on the shot.
  • SelfLift model_hires and Refine refine_model affect their own stages.
  • Keep model family/encoder compatibility consistent with the shot mode.

features.title: Build shots from other graph nodes
features.body: Connect a standard STRING output to Master prompt_text. Use one prompt per line; blank lines are ignored. No adapter node is needed.
features.detail: Image-family groups precede reference-family groups when both are supplied directly. RefPack can hold graph multimedia inputs and local selections; the bridge adapts IMAGE inputs into reference entries.

features.title: Use your own sampler graph
features.body:
• Use the Master’s Conditioning Guide Output to produce conditioning for manual sampling.
  • Director Settings provides sampling controls. Tail From Latent extracts manual continuation tails.
  • Native MiniMax H3 conditioning nodes are available in ComfyUI for standalone manual graphs.
features.detail: Use Load Take Checkpoint for durable continuation. Custom guide dictionaries are advanced inputs, not a normal Master media output. Match socket types and avoid graph cycles.
